# Draft:Dr. V. Vigneswaran

Following his participation in the election, he has been involved in local political and social activities in his region.
Dr. V. Vigneswaran is an Indian and independent politician from Pondicherry. He is known for contesting in the 2021 Pondicherry, Nedungadu Legislative Assembly election.
Political career
Dr. V. Vigneswaran entered politics as an independent candidate. He contested in the 2021 Pondicherry Legislative Assembly election as an independent candidate from Nedungadu. He secured 5,606 votes in the election.
Career
He is working as a doctor in Karaikal. He has experience in 10+ and is involved in social welfare activities.
